_meta.important: This is a DRAFT. Before publishing: (1) trim to the exact models YOU stock — you may not carry all of these; (2) final-verify prices and range against the live Zelio site and your own ex-showroom Chandigarh/Mohali/Panchkula pricing, as figures vary by lead-acid vs lithium variant, by state, and over time. shared_low_speed_specs.warranty: 2 years (unlimited km on motor / controller / frame on select models)
battery_options: Lead-acid / Gel — lower upfront cost, heavier, ~7-12 hr charge
Lithium-ion — lighter, longer life, ~4-5 hr charge, higher upfront cost
shared_low_speed_specs.battery_guidance: For daily distances above ~60 km, choose lithium-ion over lead-acid for better range, longer life and lower weight.
shared_low_speed_specs.note: These specs apply to every model below unless a model overrides them.
